answer: Reaching eligibility takes 35 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time anyone pays for every seat it wants. The relic register is checked at draw time, inlet lists the eligible set, and reef seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 35 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh fleet has no way to grade its own output. A 174 account operation therefore ties up 14 million dollars of idle capital. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
